sa: इतश्चेतश्च पाण्डूनां समाजग्मुर्महात्मनाम्। अक्षौहिण्यस्तु सप्तैता विविधध्वजसंकुलाः॥ युयुत्समानाः कुरुभिः पाण्डवान् समहर्षयन्।
en: And from several directions came for the noble minded sons of Pandu seven Akshauhini carrying flags of various sorts. All of them were desirous a fight with the sons of Kuru and so caused the sons of Pandu to rejoice.

sa: न चेद् दर्शयिता मार्ग धक्ष्याम्येनमहं ततः। महास्त्रैरप्रतिहतैरत्यग्निपवनोज्ज्वलैः॥
en: If, however, he does not show me a way (to cross the ocean), I will burn him up with irresistible and mighty weapons surpassing fire itself in fury.”

sa: श्रुत्वा शब्दं तु यं कञ्चिदुन्मुखौ सुतशङ्कया। सावित्रीसहितोऽभ्येति सत्यवानित्यभाषताम्॥
en: And as soon as they heard any sound, considering that it was (caused by the footsteps of) their son they raised up their heads and said “there comes Satyavana accompanied by Savitri."

sa: दीर्घबाहुर्महातेजा बलरूपसमन्वितः। सर्वलोकेषु विक्रान्तो भारद्वाजः प्रतापवान्॥
en: Of large arms, great energy, endued with beauty and strength, the powerful son of Bharadvaja is known in all the worlds for his prowess.

sa: अवलिप्तेषु मूर्खेषु रौद्रसाहसिकेषु च। तथैवापेतधर्मेषु न मैत्रीमाचरेद् बुधः॥
en: Should be shunned by an intelligent man like a well covered over with grass growing over it; friendship with them does not last. With those that are proud, ignorant, fierce and rash.

sa: स्वनवन्तं महाशङ्ख बलवानरिमर्दनः। प्राधमद् बलमास्थाय द्विषतां लोमहर्षणम्॥
en: Then that highly powerful repressor of foes, energetically blew his large conch-shell of thundering sound, capable of making the hairs of the body of his enemies stand erect.

sa: सिंहखेलगतिः श्रीमान् मदरक्तान्तलोचनः। तं दृष्ट्वा धर्मराजश्च केशवश्च महाद्युतिः॥
en: With the gait of a sporting lion, endued with beauty and with eyes having the ends reddened by drinking wine (entered there. Seeing him, the virtuous king and Keshava of great effulgence,

sa: न विश्वसेदविश्वस्ते विश्वस्ते नातिविश्वसेत्। विश्वासाद् भयमुत्पन्नं मूलान्यपि निकृन्तति॥
en: One must not trust another who should not be trusted, nor put too much trust on one worthy of trust. The calamity born of such trust cuts down even the very roots.

sa: प्रजापतिमिवौदार्ये तेजसा भास्करोपमम्। महेन्द्रमिव शत्रूणां ध्वंसनं शरवृष्टिभिः॥
en: In generosity equal to the lord of all creatures, in effulgence equal to the sun, and in destroying the enemies by downpours of arrows equal to great Indra,

sa: परो धर्मात् पाण्डवस्यानृशंस्य धर्मः परो वित्तचयान्मतोऽस्या नपार्थेऽनुरुध्यते भारत तस्य बुद्धिः॥
en: With the sons of Pandu humanity is superior to virtue and in his opinion virtue is superior to the accumulation of wealth. He is inclined to the through, O son of Bharata, that happiness and joy are essential to virtue.

sa: ततोऽब्रवीन्महाबाहुधृतराष्ट्र जनार्दनः। अदृश्यमाने नेत्रे द्वे भवेतां कुरुनन्दन॥
en: Then did Janardana of long arms say to Dhritarashtra "O delighter of the Kurus, let your eyes, with which you can not see, have sight restored to them.

sa: तेषां मनश्च तेजश्चाप्याददानाविवौजसा। पूर्वदेवौ व्यतिक्रान्तौ नरनारायणावृषी॥
en: As if attracting unto themselves by their own energy the intellects and energies of them all, the two ancient Rishis, Nara and Narayana, departed.

sa: अभिजानामि ब्राह्मणं व्याख्यातारं विचक्षणम्। यश्छिन्नविचिकित्स: स व्याचष्टे सर्वसंशयान्॥
en: I consider him to be a Brahmana, who knowing the Supreme Soul can expound (the rules of life) and explain the doubts of all, himself having all doubts removed from his mind.

sa: कृष्णानां मुखपुण्ड्राणामृक्षाणां भीमकर्मणाम्। कोटीशतसहस्रेण जाम्बवान् प्रत्यदृष्यत॥
en: Jambuvana, accompanied by a hundred thousand crores of black bears of terrible deeds with the Tilaka mark on their faces, made his appearance there.

sa: एवं वेदमविज्ञाय प्राज्ञोऽहमिति मन्यते। दानमध्ययनं यज्ञो लोभादेतत् प्रवर्तते॥
en: Not knowing such a one that ought to be known, a man thinks "I am wise" and from hope of gaining happiness employs himself in gifts, study and the performance of sacrifices.

sa: रथमारोपयामास विसंज्ञं पांसुगुण्ठितम्। अभ्येत्य रणमध्यस्थमभ्यगच्छद् युधिष्ठिरम्॥
en: Placed him on the chariot who was insensible and covered with dust. Then approaching Yudhishthira who was in the midst of the battle field,

sa: वर्धमानो जयाशीभिर्निर्ययौ सैनिकैर्वृतः। आपगेयं पुरस्कृत्य भ्रातृभिः सहितस्तदा।॥
en: He marched forth with the blessings of those Brahmanas glorifying him, surrounded by his army placing Bhishma at the head of his host and accompanied by his brothers.

sa: कर्णप्रभृतयश्चेमे त्वं चापि कवची रथी। मोक्षितो घोषयात्रायां पर्याप्तं तन्निदर्शनम्॥
en: Karna and all of your councillors and yourself clad in coats of mail and seated on a chariot were liberated (from the grasp of the Gandharvas) on your expedition against cattle which is a sufficient proof,

sa: तमतीत्याथ गोकर्णमभ्यगच्छद् दशाननः। दयितं स्थानमव्यचं शूलपाणेर्महात्मनः॥
en: Then Dashanana (Ravana, who had ten mouths) crossing it (the ocean) reached Gokarna the beloved place of the high-souled wielder of the trident (Shiva).

sa: मङ्गल्यार्थप्रदैः शब्दैरन्ववर्तन्त सर्वशः। सारसाः शतपत्राश्च हंसाश्च मधुसूदनम्॥
en: The birds of the crane peacock and goose species followed the slayer of Madhu with sounds signifying the attainment of the object for which the journey was undertaken.

sa: एवमन्यानि चापानि बहूनि कृतहस्तवत्। शारद्वतस्य चिच्छेद पाण्डवः परवीरहा॥
en: In this way that slayer of hostile heroes, the son of Pandu, cut off other bows as soon as they were taken up, one after the other, by the son of Sharadvata.

sa: अगारदाही गरदः कुण्डाशी सोमविक्रयी। पर्वकारश्च सूची मित्रधुक् पारदारिकः॥ भ्रूणहा गुरुतल्पी च यश्च स्यात् पानपो द्विजः। अतितीक्ष्णश्च काकच नास्तिको वेदनिन्दकः॥ स्रुवप्रग्रहणो व्रात्य: कीनाशश्चात्मवानपि। रक्षेत्युक्तश्च यो हिंस्यात् सर्वे ब्रह्महभिः समाः॥
en: 46-An incendiary, one who imprisons other persons, a pander, a wine-seller, a manufacturer of arrows, an astrologer, one who injuries friends, one who violates other's wives, one who causes miscarriage, one who violates the wife of his elders and superiors, a twice-born who drinks wine, one who uses excessively harsh words, one who opens up old hostilities, an atheist, one who speaks ill of the Vedas, one addicted to taking bribes, one whose holy thread ceremony has not been performed even through the time has come, one who secretly poisons cattle and one who injures a person who says "protect me”-all these are on the same level with those who slay Brahmanas.

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा पाण्डुपुत्राणां समागच्छन्महबलम्। धृतराष्ट्रसुताश्चापि समानिन्युर्महीपतीन्॥
en: Having heard that a large army was being collected for the sons of Pandu, Dhritarashtra's too brought together many rulers.

sa: र्यदा युक्तं स्यन्दनं माघवस्या स्तदा तप्स्यत्यकृतात्मा स मन्दः॥
en: When he sees the golden car of Satyaki, the descendant of Madhu with four white horses; then that foolish son of Dhritarashtra with a soul addicted to vices repent for the war.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच मोहो हि धर्ममूढत्वं मानस्त्वात्माभिमानिता। धर्मनिष्क्रियताऽऽलस्यं शोकस्त्वज्ञानमुच्यते॥
en: Yudhishthira said: Absence of religious knowledge is called ignorance. What is called pride is an over weaning opinion of one's ownself. Inaciivity with regard to religion is idleness. And ignorance is grief.

sa: माद्रीपुत्रौ च वक्तव्यौ क्षत्रधर्मरतावुभौ। विक्रमेणार्जितान् भोगान् वृणीतं जीवितादपि॥
en: The two sons Madri, both of whom observe the duties of a Kshatriya, should also be thus spoken to Enjoyment earned by the exercise of prowess should be preferred to life itself.

sa: अब्रवीत् कृतवर्माणं क्षिप्रं योजय वाहिनीम्। व्यूढानीकः सभाद्वारमुपतिष्ठस्व दंशितः॥
en: And he said to Kritavarman "Quickly prepare the army for action and with the division there of ready for action and clad in amours, wait at the gate of the council chamber.

sa: दमस्त्यागोऽप्रमादश्च एतष्वमृतमाहितम्। तानि सत्यमुखान्याहुर्ब्राह्मणा ये मनीषिणः॥
en: Self-control, renunciation and true knowledge-in these is centered immortality. Those Brahmanas that have great minds are of opinion that truth underlies all these virtues.

sa: सर्वैर्धर्मः समुपेतास्तु पार्थाः संस्थानेन मार्दवेनार्जवेन। जाताः कुले ह्यनृशंसा वदान्या ह्रीनिषेवाः कर्मणां निश्चयज्ञाः॥
en: With all virtues are the sons of Pritha endued, with steadiness, with mildness and with frankness. They are born in a good family, the reverse of cruel and generous, they avoid all deeds that one, should be ashamed of and know for certainly the nature of each deed.

sa: भवितासि यथापूर्वं बलवीर्यसमन्वितः। बभूवतुस्ततस्तस्य पक्षौ द्रविणवत्तरौ॥
en: You will be endued with strength and prowess as before;" then did his two wings grow up and they were even stronger than before.

sa: अस्यतां फाल्गुनः श्रेष्ठोगाण्डीवं धनुषां वरम्। केशवः सर्वभूतानामायुधानां सुदर्शनम्॥
en: Among the shooters of arrows, the son of Falguna is the chief, among the bows the Gandiva is the best; Keshava is the chief of all creatures, and the Sudarshana among weapons.

sa: ततस्ते ब्राह्मणाश्चनुरेकं सेनापतिं द्विजम्। नये सुकुशलं शूरमजयन् क्षत्रियांस्ततः॥
en: Then did those best among the Brahmanas make one among the twice-born the leader of their army, who was skillful in diplomacy and then did they win a victory ever the Kshatriyas

sa: तत्रापश्यत् सरो दिव्यं नानाशकुनिभिर्वृतम्। शतयोजनविस्तीर्णं तावदेवायतं शुभम्॥
en: They there saw a lake, suitable for the gods frequented by many birds and which extended over a hundred yojanas in length and a similar space in breadth.

sa: पृथगक्षौहिणीभ्यां तु पाण्डवानभिसंश्रितौ। महारथौ समाख्यातावुभौ पुरुषमानिनौ॥
en: The two famous and great car-warriors, proud among men, each with a separate Akshauhini of soldiers, have gone to the side of the Pandavas.

sa: जारासंधिर्मागधश्च धृष्टकेतुश्च चेदिराट्। पृथक् पृथगनुप्राप्तौ पृथगक्षौहिणीवृतौ॥
en: The king of Magadha, the of Jarasandha, too and Dhrishtaketu, the king of the Chedis-these two have come separately each surrounded by an Akshauhini.

sa: अतृप्यन्नमृतस्येव कृच्छ्राल्लब्धस्य बान्धवात्। उद्यच्छाम्येष शत्रूणां नियमार्थं जयाय च॥
en: Like one unsatiated with nectar I am not satiated with hearing your words. Having gained friends in my distress behold I rise up for subjugating my enemies and gaining victories over them.

sa: सोऽयं तेनाभ्यनुज्ञात उपकारेप्सया द्विजः। तमाह भगवन् किं ते ददानि गुरुदक्षिणाम्॥
en: This twice born one, then being commanded to go away by Vishvamitra, with a view to give him a present said to him; O lord, the time has come when I should make some final present to my spiritual guide.

sa: अत्र राक्षसजात्यश्च दैत्यजात्यश्च मातले। दिव्यप्रहरणाश्चासन् पूर्वदैवतनिर्मिताः॥
en: Here many species of Rakshasas and Daityas, O Matali, possessed of celestial weapons lived before, O Matali, which is now inhabited by the gods.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तदा कर्णो धार्तराष्ट्रेण धीमता। सर्वमाज्ञापयामास प्रायात्रिकमरिंदम॥
en: O chastiser of foes, having been thus addressed by the intelligent son of Dhritarashtra, Karna ordered (to be ready) all the necessaries for expedition.

sa: पौरुषं दर्शयशूरो यस्तिष्ठेदग्रतः पुमान्। क्रीणीयात् तं सहस्रेण इति नीतिमतां मतम्॥
en: The hero, who after showing forth his strength himself helps such men (those flying, referred to in the last Sloka), is worth purchasing for a thousand. Such is the opinion of those who are conversant with the code of morality.

sa: देवर्षयः पुण्यकृतो ब्राह्मणाश्च बहुश्रुताः। राजर्षयश्च दाशार्ह मानयन्तस्तपस्विनः। देवासुरस्य द्रष्टारः पुराणस्य महामते॥ समेतं पार्थिवं क्षत्रं दिदृक्षन्तश्च सर्वतः। सभासदश्च राजानस्त्वां च सत्यं जनार्दनम्॥ एतन्महत् प्रेक्षणीयं द्रष्टुं गच्छाम केशव। धर्मार्थसहिता वाचः श्रोतुमिच्छाम माधव॥
en: The divine Rishis and vastly learned Brahmanas of a pious life. And Rishis of royal descent, O you of the Dasharha race, as also venerable devotees, who were witnesses, O you exceedingly wise Being, to the ancient feats of the gods and the Asuras. Are desirous of seeing all the Kshatriya rulers of the earth and the countries and the kings assembled together from all sides, as also yourself, the true Janardana. We are going, O Keshava, to behold this grand sight worthy of being seen; and we desire to hear, O Madhava, words conducive to morality and worldly profit. Which will be addressed by you to the Kurus in the midst of the kings, O you chastiser of foes.

sa: दक्षिणामिति काकुत्स्थो विदित्वास्य तदिङ्गितम्। संस्कारं लम्भयामास सखायं पूजयन् पितुः॥
en: Knowing from the sign made by the vulture that it was the south (towards which Ravana had gone) the descendant of Kakustha, out of regard for his father's friend, caused his last rites to be performed.

sa: ततो देवो विशुद्धात्मा विमानेन चतुर्मुखः। पायोनिर्जगत्स्रष्टा दर्शयामास राघवम्॥
en: Then the pure-souled and the four-faced god (Brahma) the creator of the universe, who sprang from a lotus (on the nave of Vishnu), appeared before the descendant of Raghu on a chariot.

sa: इङ्गितज्ञः कविः क्षिप्रमन्वबुद्ध्यत सात्यकिः। तदर्थमभिनिष्क्रम्य हार्दिक्येन सहास्थितः॥
en: The wise Satyaki, who could understand the sings, quickly came to Know of; and in consequence of that knowledge he came out with the son of Hridika (Kritavarman).

sa: लोकः स्वभाववृत्तिर्हि निमेषोन्मेषवत् सदा। विद्वांसो मानयन्तीह इति मन्येत मानितः॥
en: People follow their natural inclinations in the same way as they close or open their eyelids; and the man that is respected should consider that it is the learned only in this world that respect others.

sa: भैक्षं विप्रतिषिद्धं ते कृषिःवोपपद्यते। क्षत्रियोऽसि क्षतात् त्राता बाहुवीर्योपजीविता॥
en: The life of a bigger is not suited to you, nor does agriculture seem fit; you are Kshatriya, the Saviour of the oppressed and should live by the prowess of your arms.

sa: सहदेव उवाच संयुक्तं एकदुःखश्च वीर्यवांश्च महीपतिः। यं समाश्रित्य धर्मज्ञं स्वमंशमनुयुज्महे॥
en: Sahadeva said Bound to us by a tie and having the same cause for sorrow as ourselves, the ruler of the earth, endued with prowess, the one conversant with virtue taking refuge with whom we seek to gain our share.

sa: शकुनिः सौबलश्चैव कर्णदुःशासनावपि। त्यय्युक्तान्यभाषन्त मूढा मूढममर्षणम्॥
en: Shakuni, the son of Subala, Karna and Dushasana-all these fools, spoke of you in a way you did not deserve, to that wrathful one.

sa: कृतास्त्रैः क्षिप्रमस्यद्भिर्दूरपातिभिरायसाः। अभिलक्ष्यैर्निपात्यन्ते तावच्छाम्यतु वैशसम्॥
en: Masters in the use of weapons who can shoot from a long distance and with good aim, let hostilities cease.

sa: यत्राकथयमानस्य प्रयच्छत्यशिवं भयम्। अतिरिक्तमिवाकुर्वन् स श्रेयान् नेतरो जनः॥
en: In a place where there is fear of great danger for not proclamation one's superiority, he who does not do so (speak out his superiority) is worthier than the other (who does).

sa: ययातिरपि पूर्वेषां राज्ञां वृत्तमनुष्ठितः। बहुवर्षसहस्रायुर्युयुजे कालधर्मणा॥
en: Yayati, too following the mode of life of the kings before him, lived for a thousand years and then paid the debt of nature.

sa: काञ्चनाङ्गददीप्तांश्च चन्दनागुरुभूषितान्। उष्णीषाणि नियच्छन्तः पुण्डरीकनिभैः करैः। अन्तरीयोत्तरीयाणि भूषणानि च सर्वशः॥
en: And which were blazing with golden ornaments and ornamented with sandal paste; and they began to put on their head gears by the help of their lotus like hands as also their lower and upper garments in all parts body.

sa: इन्द्रेणैतद् दस्युवधाय कर्म उत्पादितं वर्म शस्त्रं धनुश्च॥
en: There comes into being war, for which again was created armour, weapon and bow. For the purpose of slaying robbers were created armour, weapon and bow by Indra.

sa: महाध्वजपताकाश्च क्रियन्तां सर्वतो दिशः। जलावसिक्तो विरजाः पन्थास्तस्येति चान्वशात्॥
en: Let the points of the earth be filled with large flags and banners and let the rods through which he will pass be drenched with water so as to remove the dust.

sa: धनंजयो वा सुश्रोणि यमौ वा तनुमध्यमे। लोकान्तरगतेष्वेषु नाहं शक्ष्यामि जीवितुम्॥
en: O slender-waisted lady of beautiful hips, if Dhananjaya or the twins hear you speak thus, they will surely put an end to their lives; and they having given up life I shall not be able to keep up my own.

sa: संजय उवाच अर्जुनो वासुदेवश्च धन्विनौ परमार्चितौ। कामादन्यत्र सम्भूतौ सर्वभावाय सम्मितौ॥
en: Sanjaya said Arjuna and the son of Vasudeva, the two very adorable wielders of the bow, born in a region other than their own out of their own will are equal to each other in every detail of their nature.

sa: सत्कृतश्चान्नपानाभ्यामासीनो लब्धसक्रियः। अञ्जलिं मूर्ध्नि संधाय तौ संदेशमचोदयम्॥
en: Entertained with food and drink and having my wishes (of beholding the two) gratified, I placed my clasped hands on my head and conveyed to them your message.

sa: चलचित्तमनात्मानमिन्द्रियाणां वशानुगम्। अर्थाः समभिवर्तन्ते हंसाः शुष्कं सरो यथा।॥
en: Prosperity forsakes those who are of unsteady minds, those who have no souls and those who are under the control of their senses, even as the swan forsakes the dried up lakes.

sa: पाद्रीपुत्रौ च वक्तव्यौ क्षत्रधर्मरतौ सदा। विक्रमेणार्जितान् भोगान् वृणीतं जीवितादपि॥
en: Chose these comforts and luxuries, which are attainable by a display of your prowess, rather than even life itself, since objects attained by prowess alone are ever pleasing to those who live the life of Kshatriyas.

sa: क्षरन्ती सततं क्षीरं पृथिवीसारसंभवम्। षण्णां रसानां सारेण रसमेकमनुत्तमम्॥
en: She always distills milk which is produced from the essence of earthly things-which is of the one taste, having nothing superior to it, constituted of the essence of the six different tastes.

sa: पृथिवीराज्यमर्होऽयं नाङ्गराज्यं नरेश्वरः। अनेन बाहुवीर्येण मया चाज्ञानुवर्तिना॥
en: This lord of men deserves the sovereignty of not only Anga but of the whole world, by the prowess of his arms and by my obedience to him.

sa: तेऽमरारिविनाशाय सर्वलोकहिताय च। अवतेरुः क्रमेणैव महीं स्वर्गादिवौकसः॥
en: races The dwellers of heaven then, one after the other, took birth on earth for the destruction of the Asuras and for the welfare of the three worlds.

sa: पञ्चेन्द्राणामुपाख्यानमत्रैवाद्भुतमुच्यते। द्रौपद्या देवविहितो विवाहश्चाप्यमानुषः॥
en: The story of five Indras told in consequence; the wonderful and divinely arranged marriage of Draupadi;

sa: पञ्चावयवयुक्तस्य वाक्यस्य गुणदोषवित्। उत्तरोत्तरवक्ता च वदतोऽपि बृहस्पतेः॥
en: Skilled in drawing inference from evidence, competent to judge of correctness or incorrectness of syllogistic statements consisting of five propositions, capable of answering successfully (the queries) of Brihaspati.

sa: तथोर्धात्र्यौ सुसंवीते कृत्वा ते गर्भसम्प्लवे। निर्गम्यान्तः पुरद्वारात् समुत्सृज्याभिजग्मतुः॥
en: The two midwives then carefully wrapped up those still-born fragments and went out of the inner apartments (of the palace), by the back door. Throwing away the bodies, they returned in haste.

sa: दण्डकाष्ठमवष्टभ्य बाष्पव्याकुलितेक्षणः। अवाक्शिरा दीनमना रामो ह्यासीत्सुदुःखितः॥
en: Stricken with sorrow and grief and lowering down his head, Rāma, with eyes full of fears, face downwards, and a dejected mind, sat down.

sa: इन्द्रप्रस्थमुपागम्य पाण्डवाभ्यां सहाच्युतः। समेत्य धर्मराजानं प्रीयमाणोऽभ्यभाषत॥
en: Achyuta (Krishna), accompanied by the two Pandavas (Bhima and Arjuna), arrived at Indraprastha and went to Yudhishthira. He joyfully addressed the king and said,

sa: तमाश्रमे न्यस्तशस्त्रं निवसन्तं तपोनिधिम्। देवाः शक्रपुरोगा वै राजानमुपतस्थिरे॥
en: The king, sometime after, giving up the use of arms and dwelling in a secluded retreat, practised severe asceticism. The celestials with Indra at their head one day came to the king.

sa: परया श्रद्धयोपेतो योगेन परमेण च। विमोक्षादानसंधाने लघुत्वं परमाप सः॥
en: In consequence of his exceptional reverence for his preceptor and of his devotion to his purpose, all the three processes of fixing arrows on the bow string, aiming and letting off became very easy to him.

sa: ततस्तेन सुराः सार्धं समुद्रमुपतस्थिरे। तमूचुरमृतस्यार्थे निर्मथिष्यामहे जलम्॥
en: Then came all the celestial with Ananta to the shores of the ocean, Addressing it they said, “O Ocean, we have come to churn you for the Ambrosia.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततोऽगच्छन्महाबाहुरेकोऽमात्यान् विसृज्य तान्। नापश्यचाश्रमे तस्मिंस्तमृषि संशितव्रतम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having proceeded further, leaving behind him all his attendants that mighty, armed king entered the hermitage alone but he did not find there the Rishi of rigid vows, (Kanva).

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच धन्योऽस्म्यनुगृहीतोऽस्मि रक्षितोऽस्मि महामते। पृथारणिसमुद्भूतैस्त्रिभिः पाण्डववह्निभिः॥
en: Dhritarashtra said : O high-souled man, I have indeed been blessed, favoured and protected by the three fire (sons) of Pritha (Kunti) who is like the sacred fuel.

sa: अहं हि सर्पः प्रहित: पोममाहर्तुमुत्तमम्। मातुर्दास्यविमोक्षार्थमाहरिष्ये तमद्य वै॥
en: I have been sent by the snakes to get the Ambrosia, which is not easy to get. (However) I shall bring it to-day in order to emancipate my mother from her slavery.

sa: धनंजयेनैकरथेन भग्नान्। विराटराष्ट्रे वसता महात्मना तदा नाशंसे विजयाय संजय॥
en: I had no hope of success, O Sanjaya, when I heard that all the chief warriors of my side had been defeated by Arjuna on a single chariot while he was in the kingdom of Virata.

sa: यदा निर्वेदमापन्नः पितृभिश्चोदितस्तथा। तदाऽरण्यं स गत्वोच्चैश्चक्रोश भृशदुःखितः॥
en: He was very sorry that he was not successful, but directed by his ancestors he continued the search. He went into the forest and shouted aloud in grief.

sa: तपोवीर्यबलोपेताद्वेवदेदाङ्गपारगात्। आस्तीकाद्विजमुख्याद्वै सर्पसत्रे द्विजोत्तम॥
en: It was by Astika learned in the Vedas and the Vedangas and mighty in spiritual power.

sa: यदाश्रौषं भीष्मममित्रकर्शनं निनन्तमाजावयुतं रथानाम्। स्तदा नाशंसे विजयाय संजय॥
en: I had no hope of success, O Sanjaya, when I heard that the great destroyer of foes, Bhishma killing ten thousand car-warriors every day, had not killed any Pandava hero of note.

sa: पश्यतस्तस्य तत्ररप्यग्निसमतेजसः। विश्वामित्रस्ततस्तां तु विषमस्थामनिन्दिताम्॥ गृद्धां वाससि सम्भ्रान्तां मेनकां मुनिसत्तमः। अनिर्देश्यवयोरूपामपश्यद् विवृतां तदा॥
en: She did all this before that great Rishi Vishvamitra, as effulgent as the fire and he saw her in that state. He marked that she was of faultless features. In her nude state, the best of the Rishis saw that Menaka was exceedingly beautiful, with no marks of age on her person.

sa: तेऽपश्यन् ब्राह्मणं श्याममापन्नं पलितं कृशम्। कृत्यवन्तमदूरस्थमग्निहोत्रपुरस्कृतम्॥
en: They then saw near them a Brahmana of darkish colour, decrepit and lean, one who had performed his Sandhya and purified himself with Agnihotra.

sa: आगस्त्यमपि चाख्यानं यत्र वातापिभक्षणम्। लोपामुद्राभिगमनमपत्यार्थषेस्तथा॥
en: The story of Agastya which relates how he ate up the Asura, Vatapi; his approaching Lopamudra to have an offspring.

sa: तया स्वजनगामीनि श्रावितो वचनानि सः। सम्पूजितश्चाप्यसकृच्छिरसा चाभिवादितः॥
en: She too saluted him in return and worshipped him with bowing down her head. She then told him all that she desired to be told to her relatives.

sa: कथं परसुतस्यार्थे स्वसुतं त्यक्तुमिच्छसि। लोकवेदविरुद्धं हि पुत्रत्यागात् कृतं त्वया॥
en: were Why do you wish to abandon your son for the sake of another's son? You have done this act of abandonment of your son which is not approved by both men and by the Vedas.

sa: सोऽहं निमित्ते कस्मिंश्चिद्विज्ञातायुर्द्विजोत्तम। कालधर्म हृदि न्यस्य ततो वनमुपागमम्॥
en: By some reason I was informed of the extent of my life. And when I perceived that the lease of my life had well-night expired I entered into the life of Vānaprastha.

sa: वायुभक्षो निराहारः शुष्यन्नहरहर्मुनिः। स ददर्श पितॄन् गर्ने लम्बमानानधोमुखान्॥
en: The Rishi lived on air and was completely free from all worldly desires, thus becoming daily lean and emaciated. Thus did he see his ancestors, hanging in the hole, their heads downwards.

sa: भरतस्यान्वये जाताः सत्त्ववन्तो नराधिपाः। देवर्षिकल्पा नृपते बहवो राजसत्तमाः॥
en: O king, besides these (I have mentioned), there were born in the Bharata race many other good monarchs all greatly effulgent and all like the celestial Rishis in virtue and ascetic power.

sa: कृष्ण उवाच अर्थानारभते बालो नानुबन्धमवेक्षते। तस्मादरिं न मृष्यन्ति बालमर्थपरायणम्॥
en: Krishna said Men of immature understanding begin an act without having an eye to what may happen in future. It is, therefore, not a self-seeking enemy with immature understanding is ever forgiven by a sensible man.

sa: ते चापि बृहती श्यामे नीलकुञ्चितमूर्धजे। रक्ततुङ्गनखोपेते पीनश्रोणिपयोधरे॥
en: They were both of tall stature; their heads, were covered with black curly hair, their finger nails were red and high; they had beautiful rising breasts and hips.

sa: ततस्तु ते राजगणाः क्रमेण कृष्णानिमित्तं कृतविक्रमाश्च। द्रौणायनिक्राथसुनीथवक्राः॥ कलिङ्गवङ्गाधिपपाण्ड्यपौण्ड्रा विदेहराजो यवनाधिपश्च। अन्ये च नानानृपपुत्रपौत्रा राष्ट्राधिपाः परूजपत्रनेत्राः॥
en: Then those kings, Karna, Duryodhana, Shalva, Shalya, Ashvathama, Kratha, Sunitha, Vakra, the ruler of Kalinga and Vanga, Pandya, Paundra, the ruler of Videha, the chief of the Yavanas and many other sons and grandsons of kings, the rulers of countries with eyes like lotus leaves, one after the other exhibited their own prowess for (winning) that maiden of matchless beauty.

sa: वासुकिश्चापि तच्छ्रुत्वा पितामहवचस्तदा। अमृते मथिते तात देवाञ्छरणमीयिवान्॥
en: O child, Vasuki, having heard this curse and the words of the Grandsire, sought the protection of the celestials after the completion of the churning of the ocean.

sa: एकेषुपातेन भयं निपात्य लोकत्रयस्यास्य रघुप्रवीरः। स्तमः प्रणुद्येव सहस्ररश्मिः॥
en: Having removed the fear of the three worlds with one shaft, that heroic Raghu, Satrughnayounger brother of Lakşmaņa, holding excellent bow and arrow, appeared like the Sun of thousand rays removing darkness.

sa: श्रुत्वा तु तद्वचस्तेषामग्निमाहूय विश्वकृत्। उवाच वचनं श्लक्ष्णं भूतभावनमव्ययम्॥
en: The creator of the world having heard all this, called Agni to his presence. He said, to Agni, who is eternal like him and who is creator of all, in gentle words.

sa: तपो न कल्कोऽध्ययनं न कल्क: स्वाभाविको वेदविधिर्नकल्कः। स्तान्येव भावोपहतानि कल्कः॥
en: Tapa is not a sin, study is not a sin, the ordinances of the Vedas are not sins, the acquisition of wealth by exertion is not a sin: when they are abused, then do they become the sources of evil.

sa: दिव्येषु सर्वकामेषु समानीतेषु तावुभौ। वरासनेषु संहृष्टौ सह स्त्रीभिर्निषीदतुः॥
en: After every object of desire of the most agreeable kind had been brought, they (Sunda and Upasunda) sat on an excellent seat in happiness and joy with many handsome women (around them).

sa: शुभं दिव्यममानाममृतस्याकरं परम्। अप्रमेयमचिन्त्यं च सुपुण्यजलमद्भुतम्॥
en: It was holy, it was beneficial to the celestials, it was the great mine of Ambrosia, it was infinite, inconceivable, sacred and highly wonderful.

sa: मोक्षमेव व्यवस्यामि बन्धो हि व्यसनं महत्। सुवृत्तिमनुवर्तिष्ये तामहं पितुरव्ययाम्॥
en: I shall now seek for salvation; my heart is a great slave of passion. The great impediments to salvation is the desire to beget children. I shall now adopt Brahmacharya, following the example of my father.

sa: एवंगते ततस्तस्मिन् पितरीवाश्वसञ्जनः। न तस्य विद्यते द्वेष्टा ततोऽस्याजातशत्रुता॥
en: Having thus conducted himself and having given every one paternal assurance, he had none in his kingdom who entertained any hostile feelings towards him. He therefore came to be called Ajatasatru (enemy-less).

sa: तां मामनङ्गग्लपितां त्वत्कृते कुरुनन्दन। अनन्यां नन्दयस्वाद्य प्रदानेनात्मनोनघ॥
en: o descendant of Kuru, I am still unmarried. O sinless, afflicted as I am by the god of love, gratify me to-day by giving yourself up to me.

sa: जामदग्न्यसमः कुन्ति विष्णुतुल्यपराक्रमः। एष वीर्यवतां श्रेष्ठो भविष्यति महायशाः॥
en: O Kunti, he will be equal to the son of Jamadagni (Parashurama)and Vishnu in prowess. He will be the foremost of all men endued with great strength he will be greatly famous.

sa: एवमेतदनाद्यन्तं भूतसंहारकारकम्। अनादिनिधनं लोके चक्रं संपरिवर्तते॥
en: This mysterious wheel, which causes, the destruction and production of all things, revolves thus perpetually in the world, without beginning and without an end.

sa: प्रदक्षिणं तौ प्रगृहीतपाणी समानयामास स वेदपारगः। तमाजिशोभिनं पुरेहितो राजगृहाद् विनिर्ययौ॥
en: Walking round the fire (for seven times), the bride and the bridegroom took each other's hands. Thus they were married by the Vedaknowing (Dhaumya). Then taking leave of that ornament of battle (Yudhishthira), he (Dhaumya) went out of the palace.

sa: इत्येवं तरलतरोर्मिसंकुलं ते गंभीरं विकसितमम्बरप्रकाशं। पातालज्वलनशिखाविदीपिताङ्गं गर्जन्तं द्रुतमभिजग्मतुस्ततस्ते॥
en: Such was the ocean full of liquid waves, (it was) vast as the sky, deep, lighted with the flames of subterranean fire, roaring; they (the sisters) passed quickly over it. great rivers

sa: तेन शप्तोऽसि राजेन्द्र पितुरज्ञातमद्य वै। मृत्युस्तव भविष्यति॥
en: O king of kings, you have been to-day cursed by him without the knowledge of his father. Takshaka will be your death after seven nights from this day.

sa: दिव्यमाल्याम्बरधराः सर्वालंकारभूषिताः। उपगायान्ति वीभत्सुं नृत्यन्तेऽप्सरसां गणाः॥
en: The Apsara ladies, decked with celestial garlands and every ornament and attired in fine robes, began to dance chanting the Praises of Vibhatsa (Arjuna).

sa: उदयप्रेप्सुभिर्भूत्यैरभिजात इवेश्वरः। इतिहासोत्तमे यस्मिन्नर्पिता बुद्धिमत्तमा॥ स्वरव्यञ्जनयोः कृत्स्ना लोकवेदाश्रयेव वाक्॥
en: As the servant who wishes for promotion serves his master and as the words, constituting the various branches of knowledge and the Vedas, display vowels and consonants only, so this excellent history displays the highest knowledge.

sa: मुष्णन् दृष्टी: क्षत्रियाणां मध्याह्न इव भास्करः। ततश्चक्षुर्विहीनास्ते गिरिदुर्गेषु बभ्रमुः॥
en: Thereupon they (the Kshatriyas), having been deprived of their sight, began to wander over those inaccessible hills. Being very much distressed for the protection of the faultless Brahmana lady in order to get back their sight.

sa: श्वेतैर्दन्तैश्चतुर्भिस्तु महाकायस्ततः परम्। ऐरावतो महानागोऽभवद्वज्रभृता धृतः॥
en: Then rose the great elephant Airavata, with four white tusks and a huge body and he was seized by the wielder of thunder (Indra).

sa: संध्यामुपास्व भगवन्नपः स्पृष्ट्वा यतव्रतः। प्रादुष्कृताग्निहोत्रोऽयं मुहूर्तो रम्यदारुणः॥
en: O Illustrious man, O Rishi of rigid vows, perform your Sandhya (prayer) after touching water. The time for Agnihotra has come. These moments are beautiful and fearful also.

sa: देवा ऊचुः त्वमृषिस्त्वं महाभागस्त्वं देवः पतगेश्वरः। त्वं प्रभुस्तपनः सूर्यः परमेष्ठी प्रजापतिः॥
en: The Celestials said: O Lord of birds, you are a Rishi, you are the partaker of the largest portion of the sacrifice, you are Deity. You are Lord of the birds, you are the sun of hot rays, you are Parameshti, you are Prajapati.

sa: तडित्प्रभं वितिमिरमभ्रगोचरं महाबलं गरुडमुपेत्य खेचरम्। परावरं वरदमजय्यविक्रम तवौजसा सर्वमिदं प्रतापितम्॥
en: Your brightness is like the lightning. You are the dispeller of darkness, you reach the very clouds, you are mighty bird Garuda. You are both the cause and the effect, you are the dispenser of boons and invincible in prowess.

sa: तथा ब्रुवति देवेश गोप्रतारमुपागताः।२२॥ भेजिरे सरयूं सर्वे हर्षपूर्णाश्रुविक्लवाः।
en: The lord of the deities having said this, all those who were present at the holy pilgrimage of Gopratāra descended into the waters of Sarayü with eyes full of tears of joy.

sa: वज्राननं वज्रवेगं मेरुमन्दरसंनिभम्। नतं पर्वसु सर्वेषु संयुगेष्वपराजितम्॥
en: Its face was like lightning and its velocity the same and it looked like Meru and Mandāra; its joints were all bent. None could defeat it in battle.

sa: अश्वमेधामृतरसस्त्वाश्रमस्थानसंशयः। मौशल: श्रुतिसंक्षेप: शिष्टद्विजनिषेवितः॥
en: Ashvamedha is its immortal sap, Ashramavasika the place where it grows and Mausala is the Veaas.

sa: धर्मशास्त्रमिदं पुण्यमर्थशास्त्रमिदं परम्। मोक्षशास्त्रमिदं प्रोक्तं व्यासेनामितबुद्धिना॥
en: It is the Dharma Shastra, it is also the sacred Artha Shastra, it is also the great Moksha Shastra, said Vyasa of immeasurable intelligence.

sa: तस्य प्रजा धर्महन्त्री जज्ञे देवप्रकोपनात्। गान्धारराजपुत्रोऽभूच्छकुनिः सौबलस्तथा॥
en: Subala begot a son, named Shakuni, who through the curse of the celestials, became an enemy of virtue and a destroyer of creatures. And (Subala begot) a daughter,

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा मातुरुदराच्च्युतमादित्यवर्चसम्। तद्रक्षो भस्मसाद्भूतं पपात परिमुच्य ताम्॥
en: On seeing that the child had dropped from her mother's womb as shinning as the sun, he quitted the grasp of the lady. But he fell down and was burnt to ashes.

sa: नाहमन्यायत: काममाचरामि शुचिस्मिते। तस्मादृषेर्ममापत्यमिति सत्यं ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: O lady of sweet smiles, I would never seek the fulfillment of my desires by sinful means. I tell you truly, this child was begotten by a Rishi.

sa: तस्मिन्प्रदेशे देवेश शैलराजसुतां हरः। रमयामास दुर्धर्षः सर्वैरनुचरैः सह॥
en: At that time, in that hilly fountain there was sporting in the company of his followers, the irrepressible god of gods, the three-eyed deity with the daughter of the Chief of mountains.

sa: तस्मिंस्तूर्यशतैः कीर्णे गन्धर्वाप्सरसंकुले। सरयूसलिलं रामः पद्भ्यां समुपचक्रमे॥
en: The place was filled with the noise of hundreds of bugles sounded by Gandharvas and Apsarās. And then Rāma prepared himself to descend to the waters of Sarayů.

sa: वर्गोवाच अप्सरास्मि महाबाहो देवारण्यविहारिणी॥
en: Varga said : O mighty-armed hero, I am an Apsara, a sporter in the celestials gardens.

sa: तस्य यज्ञस्य समयः स्वाधीनः क्षत्रसम्पदा। साम्ना षडग्नयो यस्मिश्चीयन्ते शंसितव्रतैः॥
en: In consequence of your Kshatriya possessions, the time for the performance of that sacrifice has come, the sacrifice in which the Rishis of rigid vows establish the six fires with the Mantras of the Sama Veda.

sa: अभ्यगच्छन्नृतौ नारी न कामानानृतौ तथा। तथैवान्यानि भूतानि तिर्यग्योनिगतान्यपि॥ ऋतौ दारांश्च गच्छन्ति तत्तथा भरतर्षभ। ततो वर्धन्त धर्मेण सहस्रशतजीविनः॥
en: At the time (of which I speak), every man went to his wife only at the time of her season and never from lust or when she was not at her season. Other creatures also, even those that were born in the race of birds, followed this example. O best of the Bharata race, thus were born hundreds and thousands of creatures and they all thrived in virtue.

sa: ववृधे स तु तत्रैव नागराजनिवेशने। वेदांश्चाधिजगे साङ्गान्भार्गवाच्च्यवनान्मुने।॥
en: He grew up in the house of the king of the snakes. He studied the Vedas with their Angas from the great Rishi Chyavana, the son of Bhrigu.

sa: इदं कविवरैः सर्वैराख्यानमुपजीव्यते। उदयप्रेप्सुभिर्भूत्यैरभिजात इवेश्वरः॥
en: As servants, wishing to have elevation, always depend on their noble masters, so do all poets depend on this Bharata.

sa: सुन्दोपसुन्दौ हि पुरा भ्रातरौ सहितावुभौ। आस्तामवध्यावन्येषां त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतौ॥
en: There were in the days of yore two brothers, celebrated throughout the three words by the names of Sunda and Upasunda; they were incapable if being killed by any one else except one by the other.

sa: दिदृक्षन्तश्च कौन्तेयं द्वारकावासिनो जनाः। नरेन्द्रमार्गमाजग्मुस्तूर्णं शतसहस्रशः॥
en: The citizens of Dvarka, in order to see the son of Kunti, eagerly came to the royal (Public) i streets in hundreds and thousands.

sa: सौतिरुवाच इति श्रुत्वा वचस्तस्य भुजगस्य रुरुस्तदा। नावधीद्भयसंविग्नमृर्षि मत्वाऽथ डुण्डुभम्॥
en: Sauti said: Hearing those words of the snake and seeing that the snake was really of the Dundubha kind and that it was terribly frightened. Ruru did not kill it, thinking that it is a Rishi.

sa: ब्राह्मणान्क्षत्रियान्वैश्यान्शूद्रांश्चैवाप्यपीडयन्। अन्यानि चैव सत्त्वानि पीडयामासुरोजसा॥
en: They began to oppress the Brahmanas, Kshatriyas, Vaishyas and Shudras; they began to persecute all other creatures with their strength.

sa: सर्वलोकात् परं मत्वा जगाम मनसा हरिम्। अप्रमेयं महाबाहुं कामाज्जातमजं नृषु॥
en: knowing his (Krishna) to be the foremost of all persons, the possessor of immeasurable; energy, the mighty-armed, (hero), being without birth and was born among men only out of his pleasure, he (Yudhishthira) thought of Hari (Krishna) in his mind.

sa: गुरुवद् भूतगुरवे प्राहिणोद् दूतमञ्जसा। शीघ्रगेन रथेनाशु स दूतः प्राप्य यादवान्॥
en: son Soon sent a messenger to that lord of all beings, sending through him (the messenger) blessings and agreeable words such as the elder should send to his younger. Riding on a swift car, that messenger soon reached the Yadavas.

sa: ततो लालप्यमानस्य पार्थिवस्यायतेक्षणा। सौदामिनीव चाभ्रेषु तत्रैवान्तरधीयत॥
en: When the king repeatedly asked her thus, the large-eyed maiden quickly disappeared in the very sight of the king like a flash of lightning.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तस्तु गाङ्गेयस्तयुक्तं प्रत्यभाषत। शृण्वतां भूमिपालानां पितुराय भारत॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O descendant of the Bharata race, having been thus addressed, the son of Ganga (Devavrata) replied to him in the hearing of all the chiefs and potentates for the sake of his father.

sa: तस्य जज्ञे ततः श्रीमानायुः पुत्रो महाबलः। नहुषो यस्य पुत्रस्तु बभूवेन्द्रसमद्युतिः॥
en: The king Paruravă was the begotten son of Budha. He reigned in the foremost of cities Pratişțaro. He begot on Urvaší a highly powerful and beautiful son by the name of Āyu. Nahuşa, powerful as Indra, was the son of

sa: अनावृताः किल पुरा स्त्रिय आसन्वरानने। कामचारविहारिण्यः स्वतंत्राश्चारुहासिनी॥
en: O beautiful featured lady, O lady of sweet smiles, women were not formerly kept within the house. They used to go about freely and enjoyed as they liked.

sa: तत्रस्थः पुरुषैरेव धर्मराजस्य शासनात्। किरीटी जितवान् राजन् देशान् पञ्चगणांस्ततः॥
en: O king, at the command of Yudhishthira, Kirti (Arjuna) brought under his sway all these five countries and their people by sending only his troops against them and not moving himself from the city (of Senavindu).

sa: यथाकामं यथोत्साहं यथाकालं यथासुखम्। धर्माविरुद्धं राजेन्द्र यथार्हति स एव हि॥
en: He enjoyed himself to the full extent of his desires and to the full limit of his powers, as much as he desired and as the seasons called forth. But, O king, he did nothing against the precepts of religion.

sa: हृद्गतं मे महच्छल्यं यस्मादार्येण धीमता। अस्मिनिमित्ते वैदेहि लोकस्य वचनीकृतः॥
en: O daughter of the king of Videha, this has pierced my heart like a dart, that my brother, by making me the instrumental of this action has made me the object of censure in the world.

sa: आचार्यवचनेनाथ कृतस्वस्त्ययनो युवा। बद्धगोधाङ्गुलित्राणः पूर्णतूणः सकार्मुकः॥ काञ्चनं कवचं बिभ्रत् प्रत्यदृश्यत फाल्गुनः। सार्कः सेन्द्रायुधतडित् ससंध्य इव तोयदः॥
en: At the command of the preceptor, the youthful Falguni (Arjuna), equipped with finger protector, his quiver full of arrows, with his bow in hand and with a golden armour on, after having performed the propitiatory rites, appeared in the arena like an evening cold reflecting the rays of the setting son and illumined by the hues of the rainbow and the flashes of lighting.

sa: सौतिरुवाच इत्युक्तो गरुडः सर्पस्ततो मातरमब्रवीत्। गच्छाम्यमृतमाहर्तुं भक्ष्यमिच्छामि वेदितुम्॥
en: Sauti said : Thus told by the snakes, Garuda said to his mother, “I shall go to bring the Ambrosia, but I wish to eat something. Tell me where to get it.”

sa: मस्मद्देहादुपनिष्क्रम्य तात। समीक्षेथा धर्मवतीमवेक्षा गुरोः सकाशात् प्राण्य विद्यां सविद्यः॥
en: Come to life again as my son. Possessed of the knowledge I teach you and being again revived by me, O child, take care that you act with gratitude when you come out of my stomach.

sa: चत्वारि कर्माण्यभयंकराणि भयं प्रयच्छन्त्ययथाकृतानि। मानाग्निहोत्रमुत मानमौनं मानेनाधीतमुत पानयज्ञः॥
en: Study, taciturnity, worship before fire and sacrifices, these are the four means through which fear is removed. But when these four are mixed with vanity, they cause fear instead of removing it.

sa: तं क्षिपन्तं सुरांश्चैव मनुष्यानसुरांस्तथा। गन्धर्वराजो बलवांस्तुल्यनामाभ्ययात् तदा॥
en: Seeing him defeat men, Asuras and even the celestials, the powerful king of the Gandharvas, who bore the same name with him, came to him foe a fight.

sa: रूपयौवनमाधुर्यचेष्टितस्मितभाषणैः। लोभयित्वा वरारोहे तपसस्तं निवर्तय॥
en: O beautiful girl, win him from his asceticism, by tempting him with your beauty, youth, agreeableness, arts, smiles and speech.

sa: तथेत्युक्त्वा ततस्तस्मै प्रादादस्त्राणि भार्गवः। सरहस्यव्रतं चैव धनुर्वेदमशषतः॥
en: Saying “Be it so, ." the descendant of Bhrigu gave away all his weapons to him (Drona) with the whole science of arms with its rules and regulations.

sa: दिविष्ठस्य भुविष्ठस्त्वं सखाभूतो मम प्रियः। रम्यः पृथिव्यां यो देशस्तमावस नराधिप।॥ पशव्यश्चैव पुण्यश्च प्रभूतधनधान्यवान्। स्वारक्ष्यश्चैव सौम्यश्च भोग्यैर्भूमिगुणैर्युतः॥
en: Though I belong to heaven and you to earth, yet you are my friend and you are dear to me. O king of men, live in that place in earth which is delightful, which is full of animals, wealth and com, which is sacred, which is well-protected like heaven and which is blessed with fertility, which has agreeable climate and every object of enjoyment.

sa: कशादण्डप्रणुदितां काल्यमानामितस्ततः॥ हम्भायमाना कल्याणी वसिष्ठस्याथ नन्दिनी।
en: He dragged her hither and thither and afflicted her by striking her with a stick. The blessed Nandini cried piteously and came near Vasishtha.

sa: यावत्कीर्तिर्मनुष्यस्य न प्रणश्यति कौरव। तावज्जीवति गान्धारे नष्टकीर्तिस्तु नश्यति॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, O son of Gandhari, a man not die so long his reputation exists. One lives as long as his fame lasts; he dies when his reputation is gone.

sa: लाजगन्धोदवर्षैस्तु सेव्यमानः शनैः शनैः। राजवीथ्यास्तु शीतत्वात्संज्ञां प्राप महाबलः।॥
en: Then the mighty one (Sugriva) slowly recovered his senses with the shower of fried paddy and sweet scent and the sprinkling of water as well as with the coolness of the streets.

sa: बहुकुप्यकृतं वित्तं विन्दते रेवतीं श्रितः। अश्विनीष्वश्वान् विन्देत भरणीष्वायुरुत्तमम्॥
en: By performing the Shraddha under the constellation Revati, one acquires many utensils of white brass and copper. By doing it under Ashvini, one acquires many horses, while under Bharani, one live long.

sa: चलां तु प्रकृति प्राहुः कारणं क्षयसर्गयोः। आक्षेपसर्गयोः कर्ता निश्चलः पुरुषः स्मृतः॥
en: You have asked me about the Mobile and the Immobile. Hear my answer That which is mobile is Nature, which, undergoing changes, forms the cause of Creation and Destruction, The Immobile is Soul, for without himself undergoing changes he assists at Creation and Destruction.

sa: दक्षिणामवहच्छब्यः सुग्रीवः सव्यतोऽभवत्। पाणिवाहौ तु तस्यास्तां मेघपुष्पबलाहकौ॥
en: On the right was yoked and horse known as Shaivya; on the left was placed Sugriva; the who Parshni was drawn by two others called Meghapushpa and Valahaka.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्त्वा युधां श्रेष्ठः सर्वयादवनन्दनः। सर्वायुधवरोपेतमारुरोह रथोत्तमम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said “Having said to that foremost of all wielders of weapons, viz., that delighter of all the Yadavas, got on his excellent car, well furnished with all sorts of powerful weapons.

sa: ततो रामोऽभ्ययात् पश्चादाश्रमं परवीरहा। तमुवाच महाबाहुर्जमदग्निर्महातपाः॥
en: Then that slayer of hostile heroes, Rama, came to the hermitage last of all. To him said the greatly ascetic, the mighty armed Jamadagni,

sa: प्रहर्षयुक्ता बहवस्तु वानराः प्रफुल्लपद्मप्रतिमाननास्तदा। अपूजयल्लक्ष्मणमिष्टभागिनं हते रिपौ भीमबले दुरासदे॥
en: On their foe endowed with terrific prowess and incapable of being conformed, having been slain, innumerable monkeys filled with excess of joy, and displaying countenances resembling blown lotuses, paid homage to Lakşmaņa working out their welfare.

sa: यत् कुन्ती समतिक्रम्य कृष्णां केशेष्वधर्षयत्। दुःशासनस्तेऽनुमते तच्चास्माभिरुपेक्षतम्॥
en: O Dushasana, it was at your bidding that Krishna was dragged here by the hair setting at naught the protest of Kunti. That too is forgiven by us.

sa: अप्रत्ययकृतां गामर्थापनयदूषिताम्। इह चामुत्र चानष्टां तस्माद् वृत्तिं न रोचये॥
en: I do not like to follow the life which you lead, which yields evil both in this world and in the next, and which is characterised by loss of virtue brought about by discontentment and temptation!

sa: भीष्म उवाच शृणु यैर्धर्मनिरतैस्तपसा भावितात्मभिः। लोका ह्यसंशयं प्राप्ता दानपुण्यरत्तैर्नृपः। :॥
en: Bhishma said Listen to me as I recite the names of the princes who having been devoted to virtue, and having purified their hearts by penances and practiced gifts and other acts of virtue, undoubtedly acquire the different celestial regions.

sa: तथैव फाल्गुने मासि गोविन्देति च पूजयन्। अतिरात्रमवाप्नोति सोमलोकं च गच्छति॥
en: He who fasts on the twelfth day of the moon in the month of Phalguna and adores Krishna as Govinda, for the whole day and night, acquires the merit of the Atiratra sacrifice and goes to the region of soma.

sa: तद् दृष्ट्वा महदाश्चर्यमपूर्वं विधिविस्तरम्। उपोपविष्टः सुप्रीतो नारदो भगवानृषिः॥
en: Seeing that extraordinary conduct of the two original gods in themselves adoring other deities and Pitris, the illustrious Rishi Narada took his seat there, well pleased with the honours he had received.

sa: एका मूर्तिरियं पूर्वं जाता भूयश्चतुर्विधा॥ धर्मस्य कुलसंताने धर्मादेभिर्विवर्धितः।
en: There was only one forin of this great Being before. That form took birth in four forms for the multiplication of the race of Dharma which have been reared by that god.

sa: इदं चैवापरं गुह्यमप्रशस्तं निबोधत। अग्नेस्तु वृषलो नेता हविर्मूढाश्च योषितः॥ मन्यते धर्म एवेति स चाधर्मेण लिप्यते।
en: Listen to this other great mystery that is unknown to all. That man who thinks it all right when a Shudra lights up the fire upon which he is to pour libations or who does not see any fault when women who are incompetent to assist at Shraddhas and other rites are allowed to assist at them, commit a sin,

sa: न सम्बन्धं पुरस्कृत्य कृतार्थं वा कथंचन। अर्चामहेऽर्चितं सद्भिर्भुवि भूतसुखावहम्॥
en: Or from keeping in view our relationship with him, or from expected benefits (to be received from him). He is worshipped by all the pious men on earth, and he is the source of all happiness.

sa: उपायास्यति शक्रस्त्वां पाण्डवानां हितेप्सया। ब्राह्मणच्छद्मना कर्ण कुण्डलापजिहीर्षया॥
en: O Karna, Shakra with the desire of doing good to the Pandavas will come to you in the disguise of a Brahmana in order to have your ear-rings.

sa: सम्भोगसंविद् विषमोऽतिमानी दत्त्वा विकत्थी कृपणो दुर्बलश्च। बहुप्रशंसी वन्दितद्विट् सदैव सप्तैवोक्ताः पापशीला नृशंसाः॥
en: He who is too much attached enjoyment, he who boats after giving away, he to who speaks evil, he who is a miser, he who is (mentally) weak, he who praises himself too much and he who hates his wife-these seven are ever spoken of as vicious wrenches.

sa: न तान् रथस्थो भूमिष्ठान् धर्मापेक्षी वृकोदरः॥ योधयामास कौन्तेयो भुजवीर्यमुपाश्रितः।
en: Depending on the might of his own arms, Vrikodara, the son of Kunti, who was on his car, observing the rules of fair fight, did not fight with those focs who were struck down on earth.

sa: कुञ्जरैः स्यन्दना भग्नाः सादिनश्च महारथैः॥ पदातिसंघाश्चाश्वोधैः पलायद्भिर्भृशं हताः।
en: Cars were broken by elephants, horsemen were crushed by great car warriors and the foot were smashed and slain by bodies of horse, as they fled away from the field of action.

sa: एवं चेदुपसप्तामनयं रामलक्ष्मणौ। अवश्यमपनीतेन जहतामेव जीवितम्॥
en: Let us in this wise decoy Rāma and Laks mana; and if they fall into our design, they shall, without doubt, lose their lives.

sa: भर्तुरर्थे परिश्रान्तं सर्वशास्त्रविशारदः। अभिसंधातुमारेभे हनूमानङ्गदं ततः॥
en: And Hanumān versed in all branches of learning, finding Angada backward in the affair of his master, began inspire him with fear.* *Touching Tārā.

sa: यत्र सेनां समाश्रित्य भीतस्तिष्ठति पाण्डवात् गुप्तो रथवरश्रेष्ठैद्रौणिकर्णकृपादिभिः॥
en: Stays, protected by his troops and trembling in fear of the son of Pandu and depending upon those feremost of car-warriors viz., Drona's son, Karna, Kripa and others.

sa: इडाज्यहोमाहुतिभिर्मत्रशिक्षाविशारदैः। तस्मिन् हि ततृपुर्देवास्तते यज्ञे महर्षिभिः॥
en: The celestialss were gratified in that sacrifice by the Ida, Ghee, Homa and libations poured by the great Rishis, learned in Mantras and pronunciations.

sa: तयोः संवदतोरेवं भीमकर्मा महाबलः। आयाद् वृकोदरः शीघ्रं पुनरावर्त्य वाहिनीम्॥
en: O majesty! Arjuna in response to the advice given by Yudhishthira said to Sri Krishna! O god! King Yudhishthira, the son of Kunti is frightened of the valour shown by Karna, the son of Radha today.

sa: वीरासनं वीरशय्यां वीरस्थानमुपागतः। अक्षयास्तस्य वै लोकाः सर्वकामगमास्तथा।॥
en: He who on the battlefield, lays himself down as a warrior on a warrior's bed, goes to those eternal regions where all the objects of desire are fulfilled.

sa: प्रतिगृह्य ददौ लोके मानुषे ब्रह्मवित्तम। अत्र देव्या तपस्तप्तं महेश्वरपरीप्सया॥
en: After receiving her on his head, to the world of men, O you best among those that know Brahma; here was asceticism practiced by the goddess (Uma) with the desire of getting Maheshvara for her husband.

sa: समानवी? सम्प्रेक्ष्य प्रगृहीतगदावुभौ। विस्मयं परमं जग्मुर्देवगन्धर्वमानवाः॥
en: Seeing those two heroes, both arined with maces and equaling each other in energy, the gods and Gandharvas and men were filled with wonder.

sa: अधिभूतं ततो रूपं सूर्यस्तत्राधिदैवतम्। चतुर्थमापो विज्ञेयं जिह्वा चाध्यात्ममुच्यते॥
en: As connected with objects, it is colour; and the sun is its deity. The fourth should be known as Water. As connected with the soul, it is said to be the tongue.

sa: रथस्थस्य हि शक्रस्य युद्धकाले महात्मनः। ऋषिभिः स्तूयमानस्य रूपमासीत् सुदुर्दृशम्॥
en: The form that Indra assumed on the eve of the battle, while seated on his car and while his praises were being lauded by the Rishis, became such that none could look at it without dread.

sa: पीड्यमानस्तदत्रं विशेषं तत्स राक्षसः। ततश्चुकोप बलवान् सुमित्रानन्दवर्धनः॥
en: Thereat that Rākṣasa, smarting under the wounds inflicted by that weapon cut it off (by means of a weapon). Thereupon grew enraged the powerful Lakşmaņa-enhancer of Sumitrā's joy.

sa: तामेवमुक्त्वा राजर्षिर्दुष्यन्तो महिषीं प्रियाम्। वासोभिरन्नपानैश्च पूजयामास भारत॥
en: O descendant of the Bharata race, having spoken thus to his dear queen (Shakuntala), the royal sage Dushyanta, received her with the presents of perfume, food and drink.

sa: वरं कूपशताद् वापी वरं वापीशतात् क्रतुः। वरं क्रतुशतात् पुत्रः सत्यं पुत्रशताद् वरम्॥
en: The dedication of a tank is meritorious than that of one hundred wells. A sacrifice is meritorious than the dedication of a tank. But (to beget a son) is inore meritorious than the celebration of sacrifices. Truth (however) is more meritorious than the birth of one hundred sons.

sa: प्रभूतनागाश्वरथं महाजनं समृद्धियुक्तं बहुपानभोजनम्। मनोहरं काञ्चचित्रभूषणं गृहं महच्छोभयतामियं मम॥
en: Let her grace my splendid and beautiful residence adorned with various ornaments of gold, furnished with viands and drinks in plenty, decked with excellent plates and containing everything signifying prosperity, besides elephants and cars in lots.

sa: स संवृतस्तदा विप्रैराशीर्वादविवक्षुभिः। शुशुभे विमलश्चन्द्रस्तारागणवृतो यथा॥
en: Surrounded by those Brahmanas desirous of uttering blessings on him, the king shone beautiful like the spotless moon in the midst of the stars.

sa: बलं त्रिगुणतो हीनं योध्यं प्राह बृहस्पतिः। परेभ्यस्त्रिगुणा चेयं मम राजन्ननीकिनी॥
en: That of the enemies is less, it is only seven; why thus should defeat be mine; an army less by a third should be fought with, said Brihaspati. My army, o king, exceeds that of the enemy by a third.

sa: त्वदङ्गेभ्यः प्रसूतोऽयं पुरुषात् पुरुषोऽपरः। वै सरसीवामलेऽऽत्मानं द्वितीयं पश्य सुतम्॥
en: He (this boy) has sprung from your body, he is a second being begotten from you. Behold your own self in your own son, as you see your image in the clear waters of the lake.

sa: तरन्तुकारन्तुकयोर्यदन्तरं रामह्रदानां च मचक्रुकस्य च। एतत् कुरुक्षेत्रसमन्तपञ्चक प्रजापतेरुत्तरवेदिरुच्यते॥
en: The space between the Tarantuka and the Arantuka and the lakes of Rama and Chamachakra is known Kurukshetra. Samantapanchaka is called the northern (sacrificial) alter of Brahman, the Lord of all creatures.

sa: सखायः प्रविविक्तेषु भवन्त्येताः प्रियंवदाः। पितरो धर्मकार्येषु भवन्त्यार्तस्य मातरः॥
en: The sweet-speeched wives their husband's friends on the occasion of joy; they are as fathers on occasions of religious acts; they are as mothers in the hours of illness and are woe.

sa: (पुत्रेण लोकाञ्जयति पौत्रेणानन्त्यमश्नुते। अथ पौत्रस्य पुत्रेण मोदन्ते प्रपितामहः।।)
en: A man conquers the world by the birth of a son; he enjoys eternity by that of a grandson; the great grandfathers enjoy eternal happiness by the birth of a grandson's son.

sa: परित्यक्तुं न शक्नोमि दुर्योधनमचेतनम्। पुत्रस्नेहेन भगवञ्जानन्नपि प्रियव्रत॥
en: O illustrious one, O (Rishi), who delights in observing vows, knowing everything, but yet for the sake of paternal love. I was unable to abandon the senseless Duryodhana.

sa: सम्पूर्णाश्च शितैर्बाणैस्तूणाश्च शुभदर्शनाः॥ जीवितान्तकरै।रैवलद्भिरिव पन्नगैः।
en: And these beautiful quivers are filled to the brim with sharpened and deadly shafts like to flaming fire and serpents.

sa: सर्वमाविग्नमभवन्न प्राज्ञायत किंचन। सैन्येन रजसा ध्वस्ते निर्मर्यादमवर्तत॥
en: Everything being covered, nothing could any longer be distinguished. Thus when the troops were overwhelmed with dust, the battle raged in utter disregard of all rules of combat.

sa: श्वेतलोहितपर्यन्ताः कृष्णग्रीवा: सविद्युतः। विवर्णाः परिघाः संधौ भानुमन्तमवारयन्।॥
en: Three coloured clouds with their edges white and red and their middle black, charged with lightning and loO king like bludgeons, cover the sun in both the twilights.

sa: भवतो भावितात्मत्वाल्लाभोऽयं सुमहान् मम। भूयो बुद्ध्यानुपश्यामि सुसमृद्धतपा इव॥
en: On account of your soul being purified, even this is the great advantage I reap from it. With the help of my understanding I see that you are gifted with high penances.

sa: गर्जितोत्कृष्टसंनादाः शङ्खदुन्दुभिनिःस्वनाः॥ उपारमन् महाराज व्याजहार न कश्चन।
en: The din of battle caused by war-cries, shouts, roars and the sound of drums and the blare of conchs ceased, O mighty monarch, for none then uttered anything.

sa: इपूणां संनिपातेन शब्दो धाराभिघातजः॥ शुश्रुवे शक्रमुक्तानामशनीनामिव स्वनः।
en: The sound produced by the clashing of the showers of arrows shot by them, was heard there to resemble the rumble of the thunderbolt hurled by Indra himself,

sa: इषुजालावृतं घोरमन्धकारं समन्ततः। अनाधृष्यमिवान्येषां शूराणामभवत् तदा॥
en: In consequence of these showers of arrows filling the firmament, in impenetrable and deep gloom created there that became unbearable to the other warriors.

sa: शीघ्रं प्रजवितैरश्वैः प्रत्युद्याहि प्रहृष्टवत्। आचार्यं राजपुत्राणां सततं शूरमानिनम्॥
en: Who is also he preceptor of all the princes and is ever boastful of his prowess, do rush cheerfully and quickly, being borne by steeds urged to the top of their speed?

sa: क्षुद्रः क्षुद्रसहायश्च स्वपक्षक्षयमातुरः। व्यक्तं दुर्योधनो दृष्ट्वाशोचन् हास्यति जीवितम्॥
en: It is also evident that the mean-minded Duryodhana, having mean counselors, that destroyer of his own partisans, seeing the destruction of the troops and overtaken by grief, shall give up his life.

sa: किं नो विवदितेनेह किमुक्तेन च भारत। अद्यैवैतान् निहन्मीह प्रशाधि पृथिवीमिमाम्॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, what need is there for discussion in this matter) or what need is there for (your) command? I shall kill all these (men) even now, and O king, (then) rule the whole earth without a rival,

sa: वारणाश्वमनुष्याणां रुधिरौघसमुद्भवा। संवृता गतसत्त्वैश्च मनुष्यगजवाजिभिः॥
en: It caused by the blood of elephants, horses and men. Covered with the lifeless bodies of men, elephants and horses;

sa: तौ च फाल्गुनबाणौधैर्विबाहुशिरसौ कृतौ। वसुधामन्वपद्येतां वातनुन्नाविव दुभौ॥
en: Then those two heroes deprived of their arms and heads, by the arrows of Arjuna, fell down on the carth like mighty trees broken down by the wind.

sa: तमुद्यतमहाचापं दृष्ट्वा ते व्यथिता नृपाः॥ भूतान्तकमिवायान्तं कालदण्डोग्रधारिणम्।
en: Beholding the Rakshasa come with an uplifted weapon like the Destroyer of beings armed with his fatal bludgeon, all the kings of your host were filled with terror.

sa: तौ शराग्रविनुन्नाङ्गौ निर्भिन्दन्तौ परस्परम्॥ नाकम्पयेतामन्योन्यं यतमानौ महाद्युती।
en: Those two mighty car-warriors, though they were striving hard and each had his limbs torn open with points of shafts, could not make each other flinch or tremble.

sa: मया शाल्वपतिर्वीरो मनसाभिवृतः पतिः। न मामर्हसि धर्मज्ञ दातुं भ्रात्रेऽन्यमानसाम्॥
en: The heroic king of Shalva has been chosen by me as my husband; O you conversant with virtue, it is not proper that you should give me, who am desirous of another, up in your brother.

sa: संभारानभिषेकस्य आनयध्वं समाहिताः। अद्यैव पुरुषव्याघ्रमभिषेक्ष्यामि राघवम्॥
en: Do you carefully provide the things necessary for the coronation: this very day shall I install that foremost of men, the descendant of Raghu.

sa: स्वाध्याययज्ञा ऋषयो ज्ञानयज्ञास्तथा परे। अथापरे महायज्ञान् मनस्येव वितन्वते॥
en: Amongst Rishis, there are some who consider the study of the Vedas to be a some sacrifice; and who consider contemplation to be a great sacrifice which they perform in their minds.

sa: ततः शुचिसमाचाराः पर्युपस्थानकोविदाः। स्त्रीवर्षवरभूयिष्ठा उपतस्थुर्यथापुरा॥
en: And as on former occasions, men practising purity and well up in serving, with numerous women and eunuchs entered appearance.

sa: मङ्गलालम्भनीयानि प्राशनीयान्युपस्करान्। उपानिन्युस्तथा पुण्याः कुमारीबहुलाः स्त्रियः॥
en: Pure females together with many virgins brought kine &c, which were to be touched, Ganges water for sipping, mirrors, cloths, ornaments and other areicles.

sa: ततः सूर्योदयं यावत् सर्वं परिसमुत्सुकम्। तस्थावनुपसम्प्राप्तं किंस्विदित्युपशङ्कितम्॥
en: As along as the sun did not rise, all these people remained expecting the presence of the king; but then they were alarmed as to what had occurred.

sa: भीरूणामसतां मार्गो नैष दाशार्हसेवितः। तवार्जुनो गुरुस्तात धर्मात्मा शिनिपुङ्गव॥
en: These practices of the coward and the mean, are never resorted to by the scions of the Dasharaha race. O foremost of the Shinis, the illustrious Arjuna is your preceptor, O sire.

sa: वीरतायां नरव्याघ्र धनंजयसमो ह्यसि। भीष्मद्रोणावतिक्रम्य सर्वयुद्धविशारदम्॥
en: You are equal, O foremost of men, to Dhananjaya in bravery. You surpass Bhishma and Drona and others versed in all modes of warfare.

sa: दिष्टमेव परं मन्ये पौरुषं चाप्यनर्थकम्। यदहं बुद्ध्यमानोऽपियुद्धदोषान् क्षयोदयान्॥
en: In my opinion luck is the more important factor, manliness and prowess being vain and useless; since I though understanding the disadvantages of war which gives rise only to decay and ruin,

sa: अनीकानां विभागेन पन्थानः संवृताऽभवन्। प्रवणाय च नैवासञ्छाल्वस्य शिविरे नृप।॥
en: O king, the roads (leading to Dvarka) were all blocked up by the (various) divisions of his army and the secret passages (from the city) were also all blocked up by the encampment of Shalva's troops.

sa: रागी कर्मफलप्रेप्सुर्लुब्धो हिंसात्मकोऽशुचिः। हर्षशोकान्वितः कर्ता राजसः परिकीर्तितः॥
en: Raja Agent is he who is full of affections, who desires for the fruit of actions, who is covetous, cruel and impure, and feels both joy and sorrow.

sa: पराजिताः पञ्च महारथास्तु ते महाहवे सूतसुतेन मारिष। निरुद्यमास्तस्थुरमित्रनन्दना यथेन्द्रियार्थात्मवता पराजिताः॥
en: O respected king, as the objects of senses are conquered by a holy man of abstinence, so those five great warriors, overpowered by Suta's son in that dreadful fight, became confounded and inactive to the great delight of their enemy.

sa: च्छितैः शरैः षड्भिरथोत्तमौजसम्। गैस्त्रिभिस्त्रिभिः सोमकपार्षतात्मजौ॥
en: Suta's son then struck Shikhandin with twelve keen shafts, Uttamaujas with six and Yudhamanyu, Janmeyaya and Dhristadyumna with three each.

sa: न कर्म भविताप्येतत् कृतं मम शतक्रतो। ऋद्धिर्वाप्यथवा नद्धिः पर्यायकृतमेव तत्॥
en: You have not done anything, O you of a hundred sacrifices, for which you are now an enjoying this prosperity. Nor have I done anything for which I have now been shorn of prosperity. Prosperity and adversity come in succession.

sa: यो ह्यनस्रविदो हन्याद् ब्रह्मास्त्रैः क्रोधमूछितः। सर्वोपायैर्न स कथं वध्यः पुरुषसत्तम॥
en: He, who furious in rage, used to slay with his Brahma weapons even those who are unacquainted with the use of weapons, O foremost of men, why should he not be slain by us by every means in our power?

sa: तमाविध्य महातेजाः शक्रध्वजसमौजसम्। निननाद विवृत्तास्यो निकुम्भो भीमविक्रमः॥
en: And whirling this, that highly powerful one, resembling the banner itself of Sakra in energy, Nikumbha possessed of terrific strength, with his mouth wide open, set up shouts.

sa: यं तं देवगणाः सर्वे हृष्टरूपमपूजयन्। मथ्यमानेऽमृते जातमश्वरत्नमनुत्तमम्॥
en: (It was the horse) who was worshipped by the celestials, who was the gem among all horses, who rose at the churning of the ocean for the Ambrosia,

sa: हत्वा बहुसहस्राणि सिंहव्याघ्रमृगाण्डनान्। मानुषांश्चैव कुरुते नित्यमाहारमाह्निकम्॥
en: Slaying constantly thousands on thousands of lions and tigers and deer, and birds and human beings, he provides his daily food (with their flesh.)

sa: अधर्मपादविद्धस्तु त्रिभिरंशैः प्रतिष्ठितः। त्रेतायां द्वापरेऽर्धेन व्यामिश्रोधर्म उच्यते॥
en: In the Treta sin took away one of its legs; and virtue had then (only) three legs. In the Dvapara, sin and virtue are mixed half and half.

sa: ततस्तं विह्वलं ज्ञात्वा पुत्रस्तव विशाम्पते॥ अपोवाह रथेनाजी भीमसेनस्य पश्यतः।
en: Seeing him (Shakuni) in such a woeful plight, your son, O supreme ruler of the universe, putting him in his own chariot carried him off from the scene of action before the very face of Bhimasena.

sa: हताश्वं रथमुत्सृज्य त्वरमाणो नरोत्तमः। तस्थौ विस्फारयंश्चापं क्रोधरक्तेक्षणः श्वसन्॥
en: Speedily bounding out of that steedless chariot, Shakuni, the best of men, with eyes flaming with wrath and stretched bow, took his stand on the ground, breathing all the while heavy breaths.

sa: निहन्यमाना हरिपुंगवैस्तदा निशाचराः शोणितगन्धमूर्च्छिताः। पुनः सुयुद्धं तरसा समाश्रिता दिवाकरस्यास्तमयाभिकामिणः॥
en: Thus destroyed by the foremost of monkeys, the rangers of night, beyond themselves with the smell of blood, eagerly wishing for the setting of the Sun, again made active preparation for a renewal of the fight.

sa: नियतं सङ्गरहितमरागद्वेषतः कृतम्। अफलप्रेप्सुना कर्म यत्तत् सात्त्विकमुच्यते॥
en: Sattva Action is that which is prescribed in the Shastras, which is performed without attachment, desire or aversion, and without the desire for any fruit by the performer.

sa: न सौमदत्तिपदवीं गमयेत् सात्यकिं वृषः। एवमुक्तो महाबाहुः केशवः सव्यसाचिना॥
en: Have a care that Vrisha cannot send the Satvata hero to the path of Somadatta.” Thus addressed by that one who could draw his bow as well with the left hand, Keshava, possessed of mighty arms.

sa: विप्लवे विप्रदत्तानि दधिमस्त्वक्षयाणि च। पर्वसु द्विगुणं दानमृतौ दशगुणं भवेत्॥
en: Therefore what is given to the Brahmanas produces, like the gift of curds, inexhaustible merits. A gift on a particular festive day produces twice the merit and on a particular season produces ten times the merit.

sa: कृत्तोत्तमाङ्गास्ते राजन् भल्लैः शतसहस्रशः। अपतन् रुधिरार्द्राङ्गा निकृत्ता इव किंशुकाः॥
en: Their heads cut off, O king, with hundreds and thousands of broad headed arrows, the warriors of Vitahavya dropped down with blood dyed bodies like Kinshuka trees felled on every side by woodmen with their axes.

sa: मन्युप्रहरणा विप्रा न विप्राः शस्त्रयोधिनः। निहन्युर्मन्युना विप्रा वज्रपाणिरिवासुरान्॥
en: The Brahinanas have anger as their weapon; they never fight with weapons made of iron or steel. The Brahmanas kill their enemies with anger, as the wielder of thunder killed the Asuras.

sa: गोप्रदास्तु सुखं यान्ति निर्मुक्ताः सर्वपातकैः। विमानैर्हससंयुक्तैर्यान्ति मासोपवासिनः॥
en: Those that have given kine go along in happiness, their sins being all destroyed. Those that have fasted for a month, go along on cars drawn by swans.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच शौनकेनैवमुक्तस्तु कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। पुरोहितमुपागम्य भ्रातृमध्येऽब्रवीदिदम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having been thus addressed by Shaunaka, the son of Kunti, Yudhishthira, conting to his priest, thus spoke to him in the midst of his brothers.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच मुहूर्तमिव सध्यात्वाधर्मेणान्विष्य तां गतिम्। युधिष्ठिरमुवाचेदंधौम्योधर्मभृतां वरः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : After reflecting for a moment to seek out the (proper) course by the help of his Yoga prowess, that foremost of all virtuous men, Dhaumya, thus spoke to Yudhishthira.

sa: स्तथैव दिव्यागुरुचन्दनोक्षिताः। तथैव दिव्या विविधाः स्रगुत्तमाः पृथग्विकीर्णा मनुजैः प्रमर्दिताः॥
en: And the men remained intoxicated and highly inebriate with the liquor, their persons daubed with goodly aguru and sandal; and the various elegant garlands beautiful to behold, lay by themselves all around, crushed by the people.

sa: स्मरन् दुर्मन्त्रितं तस्य वृत्तान्यप्यस्य कानिचित्। अथ भीमः सुहृन्मध्ये बाहुशब्दं तथाकरोत्॥ संश्रवे धृतराष्ट्रस्य गान्धार्याश्चाप्यमर्षणः। स्मृत्वा दुर्योधनं शत्रु कर्णदुःशासनावपि॥ प्रोवाचेदं सुरंब्धो भीमः स परुषं वचः।
en: Recollecting the evil advice of the old king and some deeds of his, Bhima, one days, in the midst of his friends, slapped his armpits, in the hearing of Dhritarashtra and of Gandhari. The angry Vrikodara, recollecting his enemies Duyrodhana and Karna and Dushasana, gave way to a fit of passion, and said these harsh words :-'The sons of the blind king, capable of fighting with various kinds of weapons, have all been dispatched by me to the other world with these arms of mine which resemble a pair of iron clubs.

sa: रहिता भर्तृभिश्चापि न क्रुध्यन्ति कदाचन। प्राणांश्चारित्रकवचान्धारयन्ति वरस्त्रियः॥
en: The women, that are the best, become never angry and hold their lives, protected by the armour of good character, even if they be left by their husbands.

sa: करोत्याहारमिति मां सर्वः परिजनः सदा॥ युधिष्ठिरभयादेति भृशं तप्यति पाण्डवः।
en: All my attendants believe that I eat as usual. Through feat of Yudhishthira alone I concealed my deeds, for if the eldest son of Pandu came to know of my vow, he would feel great pain.

sa: आख्यातव्यं मदीयानां येऽस्मिञ्जीवन्ति संयुगे॥ यथाहं भीमसेनेन व्युत्क्रम्य
en: Those of my side that have escaped alive from this battle should be informed how I have been struck down by Bhimasena against the rules of fair fight.

sa: छादयन्तो महाराज द्रोपदेयान् महारथान्। शरैर्नानाविधै स्तूर्णं पर्वताञ्जलदा इव॥
en: o monarch, these warriors (headed by Drona's son) speedily covered over the mighty car-warriors namely the sons of Draupadi, with arrows of various description like clouds pouring their contents on a mountain.

sa: अञ्जलिः शपथः सान्त्वं शिरसा पादवन्दनम्। आशाकरणमित्येवं कर्तव्यं भूतिमिच्छता॥
en: If you desire for prosperity, you must (adopt these acts narnely) fold your hands, be humble, take oath, use conciliation, worship the feet of others by lowering your head and inspire hope.

sa: रुक्मिणी चाब्रवीत् प्रीत: सर्वस्त्रीणां वरं यश:।४५ कीर्ति चानुत्तमां लोके समवाप्स्यसि शोभने।
en: To Rukmini also, the Rishi, well pleased with her, said, O beautiful lady, you will be the foremost one of they sex in fame, and you will enjoy great glory, and achievements. You will never suffer from decrepitude or disease or loss of complexion.

sa: तेषां ये वेदबलिनस्तेऽभ्युत्थाय समन्ततः। राज्ञो बलं वर्धयेयुर्महेन्द्रस्येव देवताः॥
en: Those amongst them who are gifted with Vedic strength, should rise up on all sides and like the celestial empowering Indra contribute (by Vedic rites) to increase the strength of the king.

sa: राज्ञोऽपि क्षीयमाणस्य ब्रह्मैवाहुः परायणम्। तस्माद् ब्रह्मबलेनैव समुत्थेयं विजानता॥
en: Brahmanas are said to be the refuge of the king while his power is gone. A wise king seeks the increase of his power by means of the power of the Brahmanas.

sa: मतङ्ग उवाच चोदितस्तु महेन्द्रेण मतङ्गः प्राब्रवीदिदम्। यथा कामविहारी स्यां कामरूपी विहङ्गमः॥
en: Matanga said Gifted with the power of assuming any form at will, let me be able to journey through the skies and let me enjoy whatever pleasures I may wish for. And let me also have the willing worship of both Brahmanas and Kshatriyas.

sa: पञ्चालाश्चलिता धर्मात् क्षुद्रा मित्रगुरुदुहः॥ त्वां प्राप्य सहसोदर्यं धिक्कृतं सर्वसाधुभिः।
en: The Panchalas have gone astray from the paths of rectitude and like despicable wretches they are injuring their friends and their preceptors, only for having obtained yourself and your brother, hated by the pious, among themselves.

sa: एतद् दुःखं सारथे धर्मराजो यन्मां हित्वा यातवाशत्रुमध्ये। नैनं जीवं नाद्य जानाम्यजीवं बीभत्सुं वा तन्ममाद्यातिदुःखम्॥
en: O charioteer, that the pious king Yudhishthira should have gone away from the field, leading me alone in the midst of the enemy, is in itself hear-rending. Then again I am quite in the dark as to his fate. Nor do I know whether Vibhatsu is still alive or not. All these add to my grief.

sa: जगत्युपशमं याते नष्टयज्ञोत्सवक्रिये। आजग्मुः परमामाति त्रिदशा मनुजेश्वर॥
en: O ruler of men, when the universe was being thus destroyed and when sacrificial festivals and religious rites were all destroyed, the celestials were filled with great afflictions.

sa: बहुभिः पार्थिवैर्गुप्तस्मत्प्रियचिकार्युभिः। अस्मानभिसृतैः कामात् सबलैः सपदानुगैः॥
en: Numerous kings solicitous of our welfare, who have, out of their own accord, joined us with all their forces and followers, also defend them.

sa: व्यूढोरस्कौ दीर्घभुजौ नियुद्धकुशलावुभौ। बाहुभिः समसज्जेतामायसैः परिधैरिव॥
en: Then they both of expansive chest, and long arms, and expert in wrestling began to fight with their arms resembling huge bolts of iron.

sa: द्रौपदेयास्त्रिसप्तत्या सप्तभिश्च घटोत्कचः। धृष्टद्युम्नस्त्रिभिश्चापि कृतवर्माणमार्दयत्॥
en: The son of Draupadi pierced him with three and seventy, Ghatotkacha with seven and Dhristadyumna pierced Kritavarman with three arrows.

sa: चिक्षेप च रथात् तूर्ण कृतवर्मरथं प्रति। सा भीमभुजनिर्मुक्ता निर्मुक्तोरगसंनिभा॥
en: Then he huried from his own car that lance at the car of Kritavarman, with great force. That lance hurled by the arm of Bhima and resembling a snake that had recently cast off its slough.

sa: संजय उवाच तस्मिंस्तथा वर्तमाने कर्णराक्षसयोर्मधे। अलायुधो राक्षसेन्द्रो वीर्यवानभ्यवर्तत॥
en: Sanjaya sajd When the battle between Karna and that Rakshasa had been thus progressing, Alayudha the prince of the Rakshasa, endued with great strength made his appearance of the field of battle.

sa: वृष्ण्यन्धकविनाशाय किंकरप्रतिमं महत्॥ असूत शापजं घोरं तच्च राज्ञे न्यवेदयन्।
en: Indeed, for the destruction of the Vrishnis and the Andhakas, Shambas brought forth, through that curse, a dreadful iron bolt that looked like a huge messenger of death. The fact was duly reported to the king.

sa: ज्वलन्तं सूर्यसंकाशं नागं मणिमयं शुभम्। ध्वजं कुरुपतेश्छिन्नं ददृशुः सर्वपार्थिवाः॥
en: And all the rulers of men then beheld that blazing and propitious standard of the Kuru king, effulgent like the sun, bearing the device of an elephants and embossed with gems, fall down, (served by Bhima).

sa: पुत्रात् पुण्यतरस्तुभ्यं मा पुत्रमनुतप्यथाः। अयज्वानमदाक्षिण्यमभि श्वैत्येत्युदाहरत्॥
en: And consequently to your son, you should not lament for your son who performed no sacrifice and made no sacrificial gifts saying, 'O Shvaitya.'

sa: बलिनः सृमरान् खड्गान् नानासत्त्वानि चाप्युत। कृच्छ्रप्राणं वने बद्ध्वादमयित्वाप्यवासृजत्॥
en: And powerful tigers and horned rhinoceroses and other animals. Binding them by their necks and twisting the ropes (around their necks) to an inch of their lives, he used to release them.

sa: क्रूरांश्चोग्रतरान् व्याघ्रान् दमित्वा चाकरोद्वशे। मन:शिला इव शिलाः संयुक्ता जतुराशिभिः॥ व्यालादींश्चातिबलवान् सुप्रतीकान् गजानपि। दंष्ट्रासु गृह्य विमुखाशुष्कासयानकरोद् वशे॥
en: He used to tame down the very tigers, more ferocious and more ruthless than the lions. Seizing various beasts of prey and even prodigious elephants dyed with red chalksolution and bespattered with other liquid minerals, by their teeth and tusks, that highly powerful one used to bring them to his subjection causing their throats to become parched up and compelling them to fly away.

sa: चक्षुर्हणं जये सक्त मिष्वासधरमच्युतम्। दान्तं बहुमतं लोके के शूराः पर्यवारयन्॥
en: That destroyer by his glances, that one ever inclined to gain victory, that wielder of bow, that hero of eternal renown, that self-controlled warrior held in high respect by the whole world-what warriors of my army did surround that hero?

sa: न स्वाध्यायैस्तपोभिर्वा यज्ञैर्वा कुरुनन्दन। लभतेऽव्यक्तिकं स्थानं ज्ञात्वा व्यक्तं महीयते॥
en: Not by study of the Vedas, not by penances, not by sacrifices, O son of Kuru, can one acquire the status of Brahma. Only when one succeeds in apprehending the Supreme or Unmanifest, he is respected.

sa: तमेवंगुणसम्पन्नं दुर्धारमपि दैवतैः। समासाद्य महेष्वासं के शूराः पर्यवारयन्॥
en: That mighty champion who is endued with all virtues and who is incapable of being opposed even by the celestials, what warriors (of my army) approaching him, surrounded him on all sides?

sa: वासुदेवसमं वीर्ये धनंजयसमं बले। तेजसाऽऽदित्यसदृशं बृहस्पतिसमं मतौ॥
en: In whom always exist truth, (the knowledge of) the best weapons and Brahmacharya, who is equal to the son of Vasudeva in prowess and to Dhananjaya in strength.

sa: फल्गुनीषु ददच्छ्राद्धं सुभगः श्राद्धदो भवेत्। अपत्यभागुत्तरासु हस्तेन फलभाग् भवेत्॥
en: By doing it under the (prior) Phalgunis, one gains good fortune. By doing the Shraddha under the later Phalgunas one gets many children; while by performing it under Hasta, one gets the fruition of his wishes.

sa: अभिषिच्यैव नृपति श्रावयेदिममागमम्। यथा श्रुत्वा महीं दद्यान्नादद्यात् साधुतश्च ताम्॥
en: After the coronation ceremony has been performed of a king, this Vedic saying should be recited to him, so that he may make gifts of earth and may never take away earth from a pious person.

sa: तेषामपि विधिं पुण्यं श्रोतुमिच्छामि शङ्कर। वानप्रस्थेषु देवेश स्वशरीरोपजीविषु॥
en: I wish, O Shankara, to hear the sacred ordinances which they follow. These hermits, O god of all gods, are persons who depend, for the protection of their bodies, upon themselves alone.

sa: नासां स्नेहो नरैः कार्यस्तथैवेर्ध्या जनेश्वर। खेदमास्थाय भुञ्जीत धर्ममास्थाय चैव ह॥
en: Men should not love them, Nor should they cherish any jealousy on account of them, O king! Only for the sake of virtue, men should enjoy their society, not with enthusiasm and attachment but with unwillingness and absence of attachment.

sa: अवधीन्मद्रराजानं कुरुराजो युधिष्ठिरः। तस्मिंस्तदादिवसे कृत्वा कर्म सुदुष्करम्॥
en: The Kuru king Yudhishthira, in the battle that took place, accomplished the most difficult feats and killed, before half the day was over, the king of the Madras.

sa: सुभद्रा तु तमुत्क्रान्तमात्मजस्य वधं रणे। आचक्ष्व कृष्ण सौभद्रवमित्यपतद् भुवि॥
en: (His sister) Subhadra, noticing that the slaughter of her son had not been mentioned, addressed her brother, saying, Do you narrate the death of my son, O Krishna!-and dropped down on the earth (in a swoon).

sa: ततः कदाचिद् गङ्गायाः कच्छे स नृपसत्तमः। गङ्गायामाप्लुतो धीमानाश्रमाभिमुखोऽभवत्॥
en: One day, that best of kings went to a spot on the margin of Ganga. He then bathed in the sacred river and finishing his ablutions turned his face toward his hermitage.

sa: महाह्रद उपस्पृश्य भृगुतुङ्गे त्वलोलुपः॥ त्रिरात्रोपोषितो भूत्वा मुच्यते ब्रह्महत्यया।
en: By bathing after a fast of three days and purifying the mind of all evil propensities, in the large lake situate in Bhrigutunga, one becomes purged of even the sin of Brahmanicide.

sa: लोकधर्मे च धर्मे च विशेषकरणं कृतम्। यथैकत्वं पुनर्यान्ति प्राणिनस्तत्र विस्तरः॥
en: For all that, their practices relating to life or the world and the duties of virtue, vary despite these distinctions, and sufficient liberty of action is left to them by which all individuals may attain to an equality of condition.

sa: इष्टं दत्तं च मन्येथा आत्मानं दानकर्मणा। पूजयेथा याजयूकांस्तवाप्यंशो भवेद् यथा॥
en: By making an act of gift you should consider yourself as performing a sacrifice. You should, with gifts, worship those Brahmanas who perform sacrifices. By doing this you will acquire a share in the merits of those sacrifices of theirs.

sa: ब्राह्मणांस्तर्पयन् द्रव्यस्ततो यज्ञे यतव्रतः। मैत्रान् साधून् वेदविदः शीलवृत्ततपोर्जितान्॥
en: Observing vows, one should celebrate sacrifices and please with wealth, such Brahmanas as are friends of all creatures, endued with righteousness, conversant of the Vedas, and pre-eminent for acts, conduct and penances.

sa: प्राप्तः सुविपुलो धर्मः पापविनाशनम्। विमुक्तो हृदयग्रन्थिरुदारजनदर्शनात्॥
en: Having heard this sin-cleansing history you have acquired abundant merit. The knots of your heart have been united through seeing this foremost of persons.

sa: गन्धेन देवास्तुष्यन्ति दर्शनाद् यक्षराक्षसाः। नागाः समुपभोगेन त्रिभिरेतैस्तु मानुषाः॥
en: The celestials become pleased with the scent of flowers; the Yakshas and Rakshasas with their sight; the Nagas with their touch; and human beings with all three, viz., scent, sight, and touch.

sa: उत्पातके नरः स्नात्वा अष्टावक्रे कृतोदकः। द्वादशाहं निराहारो नरमेधफलं लभेत्॥
en: Bathing in Utpataka and then in Ashtavakra and offering oblations of water to the departed manes every day for twlve days successively, abstaining all the while from food, one acquires the merits of a Naramedha sacrifice.

sa: आनृशंस्यं परो धर्मो याचते यत् प्रदीयते। अयाचतः सीदमानान् सर्वोपायैर्निमन्त्रयेत्॥
en: Mercy is a very high virtue. Led by niercy people make gifts to those who solicit. Those, however, who do not beg but are sunk into poverty and distress, should be respectfully invited for receiving help.

sa: करवीरपुरे स्नात्वा विशालायां कृतोदकः। देवह्रद उपस्पृश्य ब्रह्मभूतो विराजते॥
en: Bathing in Vishala in Karavirapura and offering oblations of water to his departed and performing his ablutions in Devahrada too, one becomes at one with Brahma and shines in glory as such.

sa: श्रीमहेश्वर उवाच ब्राह्मणान् क्षात्रधर्मेण पालयस्वेन्द्रियाणि च। भृगुभ्यस्ते भयं घोरं तत् तु कालाद् भविष्यति॥
en: The god of wind said Do you protect and maintain the Brahmanas, by performing those Kshatriya duties which are yours by birth. Do you protect them even as you protect your own senses. There is danger to you from the family of Bhrigu. All that, however, will happen on a distant day.

sa: तमादिभिरभ्यर्च्य भार्गवं सोऽसुराधिपः। निषसादासने पश्चाद् विधिवद् भूरिदक्षिणः॥
en: Having adored the descendant of Bhrigu with the Arghya, the king of the Asuras, that profuse giver of sacrificial presents, sat down after his guest had seated himself.

sa: दत्त्वा त्वन्नं नरो लोके तथा स्थानमनुत्तमम्। नित्यं मिष्टान्नदायी तु स्वर्गे वसति सत्कृतः॥
en: A man, by making gifts of food in this world, is sure to acquire an excellent place hereafter. He who makes gifts of sweet meats and all food that is sweet, gains a residence in heaven where he is honoured of all the deities and other denizens. inan

sa: श्रावणं नियतो मासमेकभक्तेन यः क्षिपेत्। यत्र तत्राभिषेकेण युज्यते ज्ञातिवर्धनः॥
en: He who passes the month of Sravana, taking himself one meal a day receives the honors of Abhisheka wherever he may happen to live, and attains to a position of eminence among kinsmen whom he supports.

sa: विख्यातो हिमवान् पुण्यः शङ्करश्वशुरो गिरिः। आकर: सर्वरत्नानां सिद्धचारणसेवितः॥
en: The celebrated Himayat is sacred. That king of mountains is the father-in-law of Shankara, He is a mine of all jewels and gems and is the resort of the Siddhas and Charanas.

sa: अद्भिः सिक्त्वास्तम्भयत् तं सवज्रं सहपर्वतम्। अथेन्द्रस्य महाघोरं सोऽसृजच्छत्रुमेव हि॥
en: Throwing a little water at him, he paralysed the king of the deities with his Thunderbolt and mountain. As the result of the religious rite he had begun, he created a terrible Asura hostile to Indra.

sa: जाम्बूनदमयं दिव्यं विमानं हंसलक्षणम्॥ सूर्यमालासमाभासमारोहेत् पाण्डुरं गृहम्।
en: The car he rides, is made of gold and drawn by swans and effulgent like many suns rising together. He acquires, besides, a palatial building of pure white.

sa: अग्निज्वालासमाभासं हंसबहिणसेवितम्॥ शातकुम्भसमायुक्तं साधयेद् यानमुत्तमम्।
en: He acquires an excellent car adorned with pure gold, effulgent like a blazing fire and drawn by swans and peacocks.

sa: भीष्म उवाच दुराचाराश्च दुर्धर्षा दुर्मुखाश्चाप्यसाधवः। साधवः शील सम्पन्नाः शिष्टाचारस्य लक्षणम्॥
